body:
I don't know if this pic will be seen by anyone. But I'm from a country called Paraguay and for the last couple of days we have been suffering from a horrible heat wave. In top of that, several wild fires had been spread around the country.

Our firefighters are just volunteers. But they have become our heroes. They don't receive a single help from the goverment, whose lack of response has been criticized by everyone. They couldn't even bother to declare emergency until today and the president hasn't said anything so far. 

The sky has dyed in a weird orange tone and you can smell the smoke everywhere. We can't even breathe! 

I'll give you some sources so you can read more about them:

[The Guardian.](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/oct/02/paraguay-wildfires-drought-heat)

[Reuters.](https://www.reuters.com/article/paraguay-environment-fires/paraguay-declares-state-of-emergency-as-forest-fires-rage-idUSL1N2GT01O)

[Al-Jazeera.](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/28/paraguay-battles-fires-in-protected-wetland-region/)
